name: visualkit
description: VisualKit — AI product image, UGC & video generator for Shopify

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w marketing && npm run build -w admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server --if-present && npm run lint -w web --if-present
